seeds.name: Export a generated service fleet to JSON
seeds.description: cue export of a 1,500-service fleet built by a comprehension over list.Range, unifying each entry against a #Service definition with tier constraints and a bounded replicas range.

seeds.name: Evaluate and print a smaller service fleet with definitions resolved
seeds.description: cue eval of a 300-service fleet; eval resolves and prints definitions and constraints alongside the concrete values, unlike export's JSON-only output, so it exercises the definition/constraint path more heavily per entry.

seeds.name: Export a large generated service fleet (macOS sampler stress seed)
seeds.description: cue export of a 42,000-service fleet from the same comprehension, sized to run 3-6s so the macOS sampler has enough wall time to profile.
